title: Public-source evidence audit for Worcester dining simulation assumptions

missing_value_convention.meaning: Not found in the reviewed public sources; not proof the data do not exist.

evidence_status_definitions.not_found: No reviewed public evidence supplies the requested parameter.
evidence_status_definitions.context_only: Real related facts exist but do not identify the requested parameter.
evidence_status_definitions.partially_verified: Some factual components are verified; the requested full replacement remains unavailable.
evidence_status_definitions.historical_evidence_only: Specific historical operation is documented; current operation has not been confirmed.

interpretation.repository_note: Paths and simulator behavior are taken from the user message. No repository, configuration values, staff review, private export or survey was inspected.
interpretation.numeric_replacement_policy: No invented distribution, event lift, persona prevalence, service duration, or production rule is supplied.
interpretation.source_priority: Official operational pages and primary reports; historical portfolio/tour for design context; vendor claims and individual anecdotes labeled separately.
interpretation.scope_limit: Target dates are future relative to this research. Scheduled events are inputs; realized attendance is not yet observed.

categories.required_measure: Worcester distinct student dinner visitors by date
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: A daily meal total does not identify meal-period shares, unique people, or student-only visitors. Neither 1,800 nor 3,000–4,000 is established by the source.

categories.required_measure: Official dinner service start and end, by date
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Building hours and a late-night start do not prove a 16:30 dinner start or guarantee identical service at every counter.
notes: Use verified building hours as a separate field. Do not overwrite the dinner interval with 07:00–24:00.
An employee shift beginning at 16:30 is not evidence that dinner begins then.

categories.required_measure: Observed Worcester dinner admissions by time bin
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Traffic indicators and livestream images do not yield a verified historical arrival distribution. Queue length, occupancy and entries are different measures.
The dated calendar supplies event flags, not demand multipliers, attendance, or causal changes in crowd composition. Weekend effects also remain unmeasured.
notes: See target_date_calendar for verified date flags and explicit null demand effects.

categories.required_measure: Current service mode by counter and item
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: The 2020 tour supports Wok and Nori made-to-order service and separates Wok from Street Food. It does not verify 2026 operation; a Display category cannot establish a staffed cooking queue.
notes: Do not merge Wok and Street Food solely because one current menu lacks a Wok category.
Make-your-own wording does not by itself establish every aspect of the service workflow.

categories.required_measure: Verified correspondence between current menu categories and physical counters
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: The drawing labels and historical concept descriptions are useful references, but similarity of names does not verify all current mappings. The numeric slot identifiers are user model IDs, not asserted drawing room numbers.
notes: Do not call this a 2017 drawing: the reviewed PDF has 2021 metadata, and its original design date was not verified.
The tour associates Acqua E Terra with Mediterranean foods including pizza; this is historical semantic support, not current coordinates.

categories.required_measure: Customer dish-return opening and approach coordinates
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Dishroom 230 is labeled, but an internal dishroom location is insufficient to identify the public return opening or routing.

categories.required_measure: Servers per station by time and measured service-time distributions
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Job responsibilities establish staff deployment and queue monitoring, not employee counts, seconds per customer, parallel capacity, or arrival rates.
notes: Scanner processing time in a technology vendor description is not diner service time.

categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Menu categories, ingredients, allergens and nutrients do not validate simulator labels such as main, side, dessert, or how diners assemble a meal.

user_provided_assumption.formula: role prior / sqrt(same-role items at station) * staff multiplier

categories.required_measure: Item-level choice or consumption conditional on the offered menu
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Cuisine-level historical preference scores do not identify dish probabilities, a square-root dilution rule, portion demand, or the effect of queues and stockouts.
notes: Bradley–Terry parameters require actual pairwise-choice observations; no such Worcester dataset was found.
A campus sushi production total would not establish a probability of choosing a Worcester dinner item.

categories.required_measure: Staff-reviewed or empirically fitted item multipliers
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: No published staff item multipliers were found; an empty override is not evidence for any particular multiplier.

categories.required_measure: Share of Worcester dinner visitors who require halal food
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Food accommodation availability does not measure the fraction requiring it. Campus demographic composition cannot establish a dining-specific requirement.
notes: Do not infer halal requirement from nationality or presumed religion.
Requirements may overlap other dietary and social attributes.

categories.required_measure: Defined activity or meal-goal attribute among Worcester dinner visitors
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Intramural participation, varsity or club membership and high-protein meal preference are distinct constructs. Their populations may overlap and differ from Worcester dinner visitors.

categories.required_measure: Representative visit-motive frequencies and joint attributes
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: One student narrative supports possible motives, not their frequency, time-budget distribution, or joint probabilities.
notes: LLM-generated personas are synthetic scenario inputs, not real observations or an empirical replacement for a survey.
Rushed and social are not necessarily mutually exclusive; do not force shares to sum to one without a justified definition.

categories.required_measure: Actual planned production and actual batch outputs for Worcester dinners
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Aggregate tracked production and prep-sheet responsibilities do not disclose recipe-level planned portions, batch times, or exports.
notes: No public FoodPro production sheet or Metafoodx raw Worcester dinner export was found.
This report does not assert private data access, API availability, or the exact current Worcester planning software from an old product reference.

user_provided_assumption.batch: approximately demand in one hold time

categories.required_measure: Actual batch, replenishment and end-of-service decisions
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Public aggregate waste intensity does not identify these decision rules. A campus average is not a bound on a specific dining hall, meal period, or waste stream.
notes: Remove the proposed 7.19 oz/swipe upper-bound interpretation. Keep the figure only as an external campus benchmark.
Convert portion leftovers with measured item-specific weights, then compare only after aligning location, dates, waste streams and denominator.
The observed year-to-year aggregate difference does not measure the causal effect of a particular tool.

categories.category: Cook and hold times by role
categories.required_measure: Actual recipe, batch-size and equipment-specific production and quality-hold times
categories.why_evidence_does_not_replace_assumption: Published job duties contain no usable duration table. A generic role or food-safety ceiling is not an observed Worcester cooking or quality-holding time.

corrections_to_proposed_interpretations.claim: 1,800 dinner visitors may be low because dinner should be one quarter to one third of daily meals
corrections_to_proposed_interpretations.reason: The dinner share is itself assumed; daily meal throughput cannot validate a different dinner count.
Reviewed PDF metadata gives July 14, 2021. Neither metadata nor a portfolio page proves original drawing date or current as-built condition.

corrections_to_proposed_interpretations.claim: Street Food is the same station as the made-to-order Wok
The cuisine scores are known liked percentages and can be normalized into meal shares
corrections_to_proposed_interpretations.reason: The questionnaire and response design are not established on the reviewed slide; cuisine preference is not item consumption.

corrections_to_proposed_interpretations.claim: 7.19 oz/swipe is an upper bound for Worcester dinner line waste
corrections_to_proposed_interpretations.reason: An average over a broader population cannot bound a subgroup average or isolate a particular waste stream.
They may support scenario exploration but do not estimate real population prevalence.
